points.title: 童年成长
points.description: 弗拉基米尔·普京1952年10月7日出生于列宁格勒（今圣彼得堡）的一个普通工人家庭。父亲是苏联海军潜艇艇员，母亲是工厂工人。普京在艰苦的环境中成长，展现出坚韧的性格。他从小对柔道表现出浓厚兴趣，并在此项运动中展现出非凡的毅力和纪律性，这些品质后来成为他政治生涯的重要特质。普京在中学时期成绩优异，尤其擅长德语，这为他后来在德国工作奠定了语言基础。
points.descriptionEn: Vladimir Putin was born on October 7, 1952, in Leningrad (now Saint Petersburg) to a working-class family. His father served in the Soviet Navy submarine fleet, and his mother worked in a factory. Putin grew up in difficult circumstances, developing a resilient character. He showed early interest in judo, demonstrating exceptional perseverance and discipline—qualities that later became significant in his political career. Putin was an excellent student in secondary school, particularly skilled in German, which laid the foundation for his later work in Germany.

points.title: 法律学习
points.description: 普京进入列宁格勒国立大学法律系学习，专攻国际法。在大学期间，他积极参与各种活动，展现出强烈的组织能力和领导才能。1973年，他加入了苏联共产党，成为党员。这段法律教育为普京后来的政治生涯奠定了理论基础，使他熟悉国际法和国家运作机制。大学期间，普京还继续坚持柔道训练，达到黑带水平，并结识了后来的导师阿纳托利·索布恰克，一位后来成为列宁格勒市长的法律教授。
points.descriptionEn: Putin entered Leningrad State University to study law, specializing in international law. During his university years, he actively participated in various activities, demonstrating strong organizational skills and leadership qualities. In 1973, he joined the Communist Party of the Soviet Union. This legal education laid the theoretical foundation for his later political career, familiarizing him with international law and state mechanisms. While studying, Putin continued his judo training, achieving black belt level, and met his future mentor Anatoly Sobchak, a law professor who later became mayor of Leningrad.

points.title: 克格勃生涯
points.description: 1975年大学毕业后，普京被招募进入苏联国家安全委员会（克格勃），开始了他的情报工作生涯。他被派往德累斯顿担任情报官员，负责收集西德情报。在东德期间，普京亲眼目睹了东欧社会主义阵营的衰落和最终崩溃。这段经历深刻影响了他的政治观念，使他形成了对西方国家的复杂态度，既有警惕也有实用主义考量。1989年柏林墙倒塌后，普京负责处理克格勃在东德的撤退事宜，展现了出色的危机处理能力。
points.descriptionEn: After graduating from university in 1975, Putin was recruited by the Committee for State Security (KGB), beginning his intelligence career. He was stationed in Dresden as an intelligence officer, responsible for collecting information about West Germany. During his time in East Germany, Putin witnessed the decline and eventual collapse of the Eastern Bloc socialist states. This experience profoundly influenced his political views, shaping his complex attitude toward Western countries—both wary and pragmatic. After the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989, Putin handled the KGB's withdrawal from East Germany, demonstrating exceptional crisis management skills.

points.title: 市政工作
points.description: 1990年，普京回到列宁格勒，在市长索布恰克手下工作，担任市长外事顾问。1991年8月苏联政变期间，普京坚定支持索布恰克，表现出政治忠诚。1994年，他被任命为圣彼得堡第一副市长，负责监督重要的经济项目。在市政工作中，普京积累了丰富的行政管理经验，同时也面临腐败指控。这段时期，他建立了广泛的人脉网络，包括后来的寡头和政府官员，这些关系成为他政治生涯的重要资源。1996年索布恰克连任失败后，普京前往莫斯科寻求新的政治机会。
points.descriptionEn: In 1990, Putin returned to Leningrad and worked under Mayor Sobchak as an advisor on foreign affairs. During the August 1991 Soviet coup attempt, Putin firmly supported Sobchak, demonstrating political loyalty. In 1994, he was appointed First Deputy Mayor of Saint Petersburg, overseeing important economic projects. During his municipal service, Putin gained extensive administrative experience while also facing corruption allegations. During this period, he built a wide network of connections, including future oligarchs and government officials, which became valuable resources in his political career. After Sobchak's failed re-election in 1996, Putin moved to Moscow seeking new political opportunities.

points.title: 联邦政府崛起
points.description: 1996年，普京加入克里姆林宫，开始在联邦政府工作。他最初在总统事务管理局担任副主任，后于1998年被任命为联邦安全局局长，负责俄罗斯安全机构。在这一职位上，普京推动了安全机构的改革和现代化，打击了恐怖主义和极端主义。1999年8月，时任总统叶利钦任命普京为总理，这标志着他正式进入俄罗斯最高权力圈。作为总理，普京领导了第二次车臣战争，采取强硬立场，获得了国内民众的广泛支持。这一时期，普京迅速从政治新人转变为俄罗斯政坛的关键人物。
points.descriptionEn: In 1996, Putin joined the Kremlin and began working in the federal government. He initially served as deputy head of the Presidential Property Department, then in 1998 was appointed Director of the Federal Security Service, responsible for Russia's security agencies. In this position, Putin pushed for reform and modernization of security agencies, combating terrorism and extremism. In August 1999, President Boris Yeltsin appointed Putin as Prime Minister, marking his entry into Russia's highest power circle. As Prime Minister, Putin led the Second Chechen War, taking a hardline stance that gained widespread domestic support. During this period, Putin rapidly transformed from a political newcomer to a key figure in Russian politics.

points.title: 国家领导人
points.description: 1999年12月31日，叶利钦突然辞职，普京出任代总统。2000年3月，他正式当选为俄罗斯总统，开启了长达二十多年的统治时期。普京执政期间，强化中央权力，打击寡头政治，恢复国家稳定；推动经济改革，利用能源资源优势使俄罗斯经济快速增长；采取强硬的外交政策，维护俄罗斯国际地位。2008-2012年担任总理，2012年再次当选总统，随后通过修宪可在2024年后继续执政。普京的统治使俄罗斯重新成为国际重要力量，但也面临西方制裁、国内反对派压制和乌克兰危机等挑战。他的统治风格被形容为'垂直权力'，强调国家主权和强大中央政府。
points.descriptionEn: On December 31, 1999, Yeltsin unexpectedly resigned, and Putin became Acting President. In March 2000, he was officially elected President of Russia, beginning over two decades of rule. During Putin's presidency, he strengthened central power, curbed oligarchic politics, and restored national stability; he pushed economic reforms, leveraging energy resources to achieve rapid economic growth; and adopted a hardline foreign policy to maintain Russia's international standing. He served as Prime Minister from 2008-2012 and was re-elected president in 2012, later amending the constitution to potentially continue ruling beyond 2024. Putin's rule has restored Russia as a significant international power, but also faces challenges including Western sanctions, suppression of domestic opposition, and the Ukraine crisis. His governing style is characterized as 'vertical power,' emphasizing state sovereignty and a strong central government.

supporter.zh: 支持者视普京为俄罗斯国家复兴的强人领袖，认为他结束了叶利钦时代的混乱与动荡，恢复了国家稳定与尊严。普京带领俄罗斯走出经济困境，利用能源优势实现经济增长，提高了民众生活水平。在国际舞台上，他捍卫了俄罗斯的国家利益，使俄罗斯重新成为世界重要一极。支持者赞扬他的爱国主义精神、决断力和对西方霸权的抵抗，认为他代表了俄罗斯传统价值观和主权国家的尊严。
supporter.en: Supporters view Putin as a strong leader who restored Russia's national revival, ending the chaos and turmoil of the Yeltsin era and restoring national stability and dignity. Under his leadership, Russia emerged from economic difficulties, leveraged energy resources for economic growth, and improved living standards. On the international stage, he defended Russia's national interests, restoring Russia as a major global power. Supporters praise his patriotism, decisiveness, and resistance to Western hegemony, seeing him as representing traditional Russian values and the dignity of a sovereign nation.

critic.zh: 批评者指责普京建立威权统治，压制民主自由，控制媒体，打压政治反对派和公民社会。他们批评他集中权力，削弱制衡机制，导致腐败问题严重。在国际事务中，批评者认为普京采取侵略性政策，如吞并克里米亚、介入乌克兰东部冲突，破坏国际秩序。批评者还指出，尽管普京宣称改善民生，但俄罗斯经济结构单一，过度依赖能源，贫富差距扩大，中产阶级发展受限。他的统治被批评为倒退，使俄罗斯远离民主化进程。
critic.en: Critics accuse Putin of establishing an authoritarian regime, suppressing democratic freedoms, controlling media, and persecuting political opposition and civil society. They argue that he has concentrated power, weakened checks and balances, and allowed corruption to flourish. In international affairs, critics contend that Putin has pursued aggressive policies, such as annexing Crimea and intervening in eastern Ukraine, undermining international order. Critics also note that despite claims of improving living standards, Russia's economy remains overly dependent on energy resources, with growing wealth inequality and limited development of the middle class. His rule is seen as regressive, moving Russia away from democratic processes.

objective.zh: 客观历史视角下，普京被视为后苏联时代俄罗斯转型的关键人物，其统治反映了俄罗斯寻求国家定位的复杂过程。在历史学界，普京常被分析为实用主义政治家，结合了俄罗斯传统威权治理模式与现代国家治理需求。流行文化中，普京形象多元，既是强硬的'强人'领袖，也是柔道高手和热爱动物的形象。他的统治代表了俄罗斯对西方模式的反思与重新定位，体现了后冷战时期大国寻求新平衡的尝试。普京时代标志着俄罗斯从苏联解体后的混乱走向稳定，但也伴随着与西方关系的持续紧张。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Putin is viewed as a pivotal figure in Russia's post-Soviet transformation, with his rule reflecting the complex process of Russia's search for national identity. In historical scholarship, Putin is often analyzed as a pragmatic politician combining traditional Russian authoritarian governance models with modern state administration needs. In popular culture, Putin's image is multifaceted—portrayed as both a strongman leader and a judo master and animal lover. His era represents Russia's reflection on and repositioning relative to Western models, embodying the attempts of major powers to find a new balance in the post-Cold War era. Putin's period marks Russia's transition from post-Soviet chaos to stability, yet伴随着 continued tensions with the West.

self.zh: 谁不怀念苏联，谁就没有良心；谁想回到苏联，谁就没有头脑。
self.en: Whoever does not miss the Soviet Union has no heart; whoever wants to return to the Soviet Union has no brain.
